name: prism-mapper
description: Free, open-source projection mapping for Windows, Mac, Android, iPhone and iPad. A half vibe-coded, half-tested project.

scripts.format: prettier --write src electron tests scripts index.html vite.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src electron tests scripts index.html vite.config.ts
scripts.android:open: npm run build && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run build && cap run android
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
scripts.ios:open: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run build && cap run ios
scripts.ios:simulator: npm run build && cap sync ios && xcodebuild build -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/App/build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.test:show: node tests/show-playback.cjs && node tests/show-ui.cjs && node tests/show-header.cjs
